product_brief: API Security and JWT Libraries supporting NIST PQC standardized algorithms for quantum-resistant encryption and signatures.
pqc_capability_description: Implements NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA), and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA). Supports hybrid composite keys (Classical + PQC) using NIST-approved HKDF-SHA256. Provides API access for key generation, encryption, and signing.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128f, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256f, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256s, RSA-4096, RSA-2048, X25519, Ed25519, AES-256, HKDF-SHA256
key_management_model: Hybrid composite keys; FIPS-validated HSM-backed (Thales Luna, AWS CloudHSM, Entrust nShield)
architecture_type: API-based; Algorithm-agnostic architecture; Hybrid composite key architecture
fips_validated: No (States "FIPS 140-2 module coverage via customer-deployed FIPS-validated HSM"; algorithms are NIST FIPS 203/204/205 compliant but module validation is via external HSM)
primary_platforms: API access; Federal cloud deployment options (customer-operated GovCloud)
regulatory_status: GSA Schedule ready; Compliant with Executive Order 14144; Aligned with NSA CNSA 2.0; OMB M-23-02 compliant
pqc_roadmap_details: Implemented NIST standards by November 2024. Strategy involves hybrid composite keys for gradual transition (2025-2030) to pure PQC by 2030.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128f, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256f, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s, SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256s, Ed25519 (hybrid), ECDSA (deprecated/rejected)
implementation_attack_surface: SLH-DSA is immune to side-channel attacks due to stateless nature. No other specific side-channel vulnerabilities mentioned.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Inventory tool available to scan systems for RSA/ECDSA usage (enterprise feature).
testing_&_validation_methods: Automated compliance test suite provided; CAVP certificate mentioned for algorithms; Tests include ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Hybrid KDF, and weak algorithm rejection.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports gradual transition via hybrid keys; API-level migration; rejects weak algorithms automatically.
organizational_readiness: Requires API access; Enterprise features for inventory and reporting available.

product_brief: Ground-up, formally verified PQC library offering cryptographic agility, sovereignty, and constant-time execution for enterprise deployment.
pqc_support: Yes (Active implementation of ML-KEM, ML-DSA, HQC, SLH-DSA, and Hybrid TLS)
pqc_capability_description: CipherForge provides active orchestration of NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-65), FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA), and HQC-192. It supports Hybrid TLS (X25519MLKEM768). Algorithms are updated via configuration without infrastructure changes. Implementation uses Jasmin for constant-time execution and formal verification.
key_management_model: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key), Zero-storage, Pre-Shared Key Mode
architecture_type: API-Orchestrated, Jasmin/C Hybrid Implementation, Air-gapped ready
license: Proprietary (License optimized source or compiled code)
fips_validated: No (References NIST FIPS 203/204/205 standards for algorithms, but does not state FIPS 140 validation status)
primary_platforms: Python, C, Jasmin; On-premise; Embedded systems; IoT devices; Drones
target_industries: Enterprise, Government, Critical Infrastructure, Finance (implied by compliance standards)
regulatory_status: ISO 27001 certified; Listed in Austrade's national quantum capability report; Compliant with NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, APRA CPS 230, ASD ISM 2030, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, ENISA PQC Guidelines, AUKUS Tech Cooperation
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports seamless switching as NIST and ENISA guidance evolves; API contract stays the same; updates delivered as configuration.
implementation_attack_surface: Claims to eliminate timing side-channels by construction using Jasmin; asserts vulnerabilities affecting Signal, AWS, and Cloudflare cannot occur; claims no nonce reuse or memory safety issues due to formal proof.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Provides full cryptographic inventory across various attack surfaces; migration roadmaps aligned to mandates.
testing_&_validation_methods: Formal verification (Jasmin); constant-time execution proof at assembly level; outperforms C reference on throughput.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Suitable for embedded systems, IoT devices, and drones via Pre-Shared Key mode to reduce handshake delays and TLS dependence.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: No external dependency for air-gapped deployments; source code handover available; not a wrapper around NIST reference code.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Low complexity; updates via configuration without patching, regression testing, or emergency change requests; integration in hours.
organizational_readiness: Developer-friendly ("PQC without the PhD"); clean API abstraction; no need to understand cryptography to integrate correctly.

fips_validated: Yes (supports FIPS-aligned suites for government workloads)
target_industries: Enterprise, Government, Finance (PCI DSS, Open Banking)
regulatory_status: Supports compliance with PCI DSS, Open Banking, and FIPS
pqc_roadmap_details: Provides policies to prepare for a future with quantum-capable threat actors; allows testing and adopting quantum-resistant algorithms as standards evolve.
